body:
Hey! It's here to expose a feature of the RefinementList (component) to the widget.

So that if you want to build a list of checkboxes where only one checkbox can be ticked at a time, while still displaying the other options then you use refinementList + singleRefine, then you can.

Like "shipping options" (point relais, collissimo..) it fits in it, while using a menu for shipping options may not be obvious to the user.

What do you think?
